text: The authorities made considerable progress implementing 2022 FSAP policy recommendations, though revenue base broadening progress remains slow and no formal fiscal anchor has been announced. Key figures include delivering 300,000 homes for 2025–2030 under the Delivering Homes, Building Communities 2025–2030 plan, alongside the MTFSP 2025 framework and the 2026 Regulatory and Supervisory Outlook. IMF staff recommendations call for maintaining a broadly neutral fiscal stance in the MTFSP, establishing a credible fiscal anchor, continuing close monitoring of credit, liquidity and operational risks for banks, and removing rent controls.
